purpose: Fresh primary-source follow-up for 36 V, lower-current J2 candidates omitted from the earlier 26-record survey. Research only; active inputs and original source catalog are unchanged.
scope: Complete STEPPERONLINE BLDC motors without a built-in reducer, approximately 0.4-0.6 Nm, motor-only price at most USD 50 and body length strictly below 100 mm.
current_definition: The inspected pages say Rated Current only. Whether this is DC supply current, phase RMS current or phase peak current is not established. Phase current cannot be inferred from supply voltage alone.
thermal_policy: Do not rank motor heating from listed amperes alone. Current convention, winding resistance convention, commutation, torque constant and thermal operating point are required. No copper-loss or efficiency value is fabricated.
pdf_status: Direct files.omc-stepperonline.com and omc-stepperonline.com/download full-datasheet URLs were not accessible through the web tool in this follow-up. Facts below are verified against the current primary product-page specification tables; no additional PDF-byte or visual confirmation is claimed.

eligible_candidates.mass_scope: Net motor weight from Physical Specification; distinct from 1.13 kg gross shipping weight
eligible_candidates.price_scope: Single motor China listing, before freight/tax and excluding drive and encoder
eligible_candidates.comparison: Compared with the selected 24 V BLR70, listed current is lower (5.4 vs 10.4 A), body is 19.5 mm longer and net mass is 380 g higher; rated torque/speed also differ. This is not a demonstrated efficiency improvement.

eligible_candidates.mass_scope: Net motor weight from Physical Specification; distinct from 0.91 kg gross shipping weight
eligible_candidates.price_scope: Single motor China listing, before freight/tax and excluding drive and encoder
eligible_candidates.comparison: Same listed torque/speed/current as BYA94 but 220 g lighter, 2.5 mm longer and square rather than round. Compared with the selected BLR70, net mass is 160 g higher and body is 22 mm longer.

other_checked_candidates.decision: Does not satisfy the current strictly less than 100 mm body rule; it is exactly 100 mm.
Body is too long for the current less-than-100 mm rule.
